notes: Identity independently checked: title The Substitutability of Physical and Social Warmth in Daily Life, John A. Bargh and Idit Shalev, DOI 10.1037/a0023527 match the original reference. This is a primary research article text with methods, results, references and appendices, bearing the May 23, 2011 advance-online citation rather than the 2012 issue citation. No PDF was supplied. Supplied page locators for Studies 1a/1b differ from the advance-online printed pagination; study headings establish candidate sections. No replication source or reported-success field is assigned. Printed candidate pairs: duration r=.33, p<.05; temperature r=.34, p<.05; frequency r=.03, p>.25; summary index r=.37, p=.017. The neutral description does not distinguish these outcomes, so no candidate is selected. Sex counts 16 female and 25 male describe recruitment, not explicit mutually exclusive final analytic groups; no analytic N sum is made. Methods use the same survey as Study 1a. All assigned fields examined; null values reflect unresolved target correspondence, not absence of printed results. Unassigned fields are placeholders.
